welcome_lead: Black keys, semitones and key signatures.

concepts.def: Raises a note by a semitone — ♯.

walkthroughs.body_html: A sharp (♯) raises a note by a semitone — one step up. F♯ is one key higher than F.
A flat (♭) lowers a note by a semitone. B♭ is one key lower than B. A natural (♮) sign cancels a previous sharp or flat.
A key signature shows sharps or flats at the start of every line. C major has none. G major has 1 sharp. F major has 1 flat.
